biography: Grant Polley is an experienced professional in land and data center development. He spent four years at North Point Development, focusing on industrial land development, entitlements, diligence, pre-engineering, and civil relationships. He then applied these skills to data center development at Tract, where he managed six projects in Iowa, Chicago, and Central Virginia. He left Tract seeking full end-to-end process ownership and long-term profit sharing. He is currently navigating an 18-month non-compete from Tract.
